Page 38 July Ist Albert Lukaszewski - 52 - head-aches, losing weight, not able to work since April.
Eliz Beaubien - 55 - palsey; her husband and five children join her in asking prayers.
Mrs. Flanagan - 91 - and sister - 94
Thanks - Alice Beidigare - 48 - eye saved - Dr. Thought it cancer - can't understand how it was cured.
5 Thed. Mancuso of Cleveland - 4 - "Miraculisy cured of ostemalitis when 14 months - is threatened again. Enrolled To-day perpetually in S.M.Assoc.
5 Thomas Ryun - 47 - formerly pol .- fearful arthritis since 1938 - quite helpless - Drs say no cure for him.
6 Don. Ferguson - 37 - left home - wife and five-yr .- old son - look- ing for work June 5th. - No word has been Rec'd since and no trace of his car .... 14556 Scripps.
Thanks. Helen Wright 2nd Ave. - 32 - non Cath. - Enrolled % phone - Expecting operation - cancer on uter. next day ... promised to go to holy Mass ten times ... no operation necessary. Deo Gr. Now taking instructions.
Page 39 July 6 Leo Kalahar - 50 - of Traverse City - last Sept. promised $5. per month per missions if cured of cancer .... Drs gave him 3 months to live ... has gained 50 1bs last 6 months - very active - hold better position than before ....
Wm. A. Petzold -
7 Baby Mary M. McDonald - 5 mo. - deaf and blind - one of 8 children -naturally parents quite concerned ....
Rose M. Sottik of Toledo - anxious to sell property. ... before los- ing ....
8 Iris Ann Cody - 3 in August - very peculiar bone disease, ostama- litis - one leg broken 5 times - the other twice.
Gloria M.A. Oliver - 4 of Oxford, Mich. Threatened with loss of eye - cataract ..
